description: Search new cars for lease or finance in California. Every car comes with its monthly payment for the stated credit tier and a deal_url, a page where the buyer finishes personally.

body.description: Body style filter, for example SUV, Sedan, Truck.

credit_tier.description: Buyer credit tier by score: t1 = Tier 1 · 740+, t2 = Tier 2 · 720-739, t3 = Tier 3 · 680-719, t4 = Tier 4 · 660-679, t5 = Tier 5 · 620-659, t6 = Tier 6 · <620. Payments are calculated for every tier in this list, so pass the buyer's own tier. If omitted, the calculation uses t1. A payment is final only for the tier you name, and the bank decides approval.

due_at_signing_usd.description: Amount due at signing in dollars. Default is the amount shown on the site for this car.

fuel.description: Fuel filter, for example Gas, Hybrid, Electric.

lang.description: Language of the page behind deal_url. Default en.

make.description: Make, one of: Hyundai, Kia, Nissan, Chevrolet, Volkswagen, Mazda, Subaru, Genesis, Honda, Toyota, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Lexus, Acura, INFINITI, GMC, Cadillac, Jeep, Ford, Volvo, Chrysler, Ram, Dodge, Buick.

model.description: Exact model name, for example K5. Zero results return available_models.

page.description: Page, up to 5. For more cars narrow the search.

search.description: Free text over make, model and trim.

zip.description: Buyer California ZIP, sets the tax rate. Default 90210.

name: find_cars
title: Find cars
